items.t: Official boundary: the City of Delta publishes no boundary for the Boundary Beach name.

faq.q: What park and beach serve Boundary Beach?
faq.a: Boundary Bay Regional Park and Centennial Beach (570 Boundary Bay Rd, Metro Vancouver), with the Dyke Trail, the Savannah and Raptor trails and Cammidge House; the park is an internationally recognized Important Bird Area on the Pacific Flyway.

faq.q: What flood and foreshore rules apply to a waterfront home here?
faq.a: Hazard Development Permit Area SD3 (Boundary Bay Foreshore and the Southlands) sets a 2.9 m GSC datum minimum floor level, a 2.3 m minimum land surface elevation and a 7.5 m setback from the natural boundary of a tidal area, the shore sits behind the Boundary Bay dike maintained by the City of Delta, and the foreshore itself is provincial Crown land held by lease or licence.
